text: ajjhattaṃ sukhadukkhanti . no hetaṃ bhante . evaṃ passaṃ bhikkhave sutavā ariyasāvako cakkhusmiṃpi nibbindati .pe. jivhāyapi nibbindati manasmiṃpi nibbindati nibbindaṃ virajjati virāgā vimuccati . vimuttasmiṃ vimuttamiti ñāṇaṃ hoti . khīṇā jāti vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ nāparaṃ itthattāyāti pajānātīti . dutiyaṃ . [154] dukkhassa bhikkhave samudayañca atthaṅgamañca desissāmi taṃ suṇātha . katamo ca bhikkhave dukkhassa samudayo . cakkhuñca paṭicca rūpe ca uppajjati cakkhuviññāṇaṃ tiṇṇaṃ saṅgati phasso phassapaccayā vedanā vedanāpaccayā taṇhā ayaṃ dukkhassa
